dictionaries.name: Sample: Volume 164 vocabulary
dictionaries.description: Every word form in the original texts of Volume 164 (Writings and Utterances of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, 1914, part II), with pronunciation, a one-word gloss and a short definition. A test dictionary for word study; readings marked uncertain in the notes need review.
dictionaries.source: AI-generated from the Volume 164 texts in November 2026; not reviewed by a translator.
about: Scope: every written word form in the Persian and Arabic originals of Volume 164 of the collection (Writings and Utterances of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, 1914, part II), the volume chosen to try out word study. It is the base dictionary; the Hidden Words, Kitáb-i-Íqán and Kitáb-i-Aqdas dictionary adds only the forms that are not already here.

What an entry is: one entry per written form exactly as it appears in the text (search spelling: no vowel marks, ی and ک unified), so plurals and other inflected forms have their own entries. A form with two common readings has a row for each, the one that fits these texts first.

Contents: vowelled spelling, pronunciation in the Bahá'í transliteration, part of speech, Arabic root, a plain gloss and a Bahá'í English rendering in Shoghi Effendi's style, tags (Elevated style, Archaic, Literary, Religious, Bahá'í term, Qur'anic, Mystical, Honorific, Meaning shifted, Arabic loan), a modern equivalent with its pronunciation and meaning, a meaning-shift note where the meaning differs today, a definition, and a note on how the word is used in the Bahá'í Writings.

How it was made: generated with AI in November 2026, in batches, from each word's context in these texts, with automatic checks (for example that vowelled forms keep the letters of the text and that tags are valid). It has not been reviewed by a translator; 25 entries are marked as uncertain readings. Meanings were chosen to fit these texts and may not fit other uses of the same word.

dictionaries.name: Sample: Hidden Words, Kitáb-i-Íqán and Kitáb-i-Aqdas vocabulary
dictionaries.description: Word forms of the Hidden Words (Persian and Arabic), the Kitáb-i-Íqán and the Kitáb-i-Aqdas not already in the Volume 164 sample, with vowelled spelling, pronunciation, part of speech, Arabic root, plain gloss, Bahá'í English rendering, register, categories, modern equivalent, definition and Bahá'í usage. A test dictionary; entries marked uncertain need review first.
dictionaries.source: AI-generated from these texts in November 2026; not reviewed by a translator.
about: Scope: the word forms of the Hidden Words (Persian and Arabic), the Kitáb-i-Íqán and the Kitáb-i-Aqdas that are not already in the Volume 164 dictionary. Together the two dictionaries cover every word form of these books: common words such as و or از are in the Volume 164 dictionary, and this one adds the rest (7,876 more forms).

Why these books: they are among Bahá'u'lláh's best-known works, read widely in Shoghi Effendi's translations, and they add much of the Arabic and scriptural vocabulary that ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's letters in Volume 164 lack. Pronunciations of the Arabic texts follow classical recitation where case endings are clearly pronounced.

What an entry is and what it contains: the same as the Volume 164 dictionary — one entry per written form, a row per common reading, with vowelled spelling, pronunciation, part of speech, root, plain and Bahá'í English glosses (preferring Shoghi Effendi's actual wording in these books), tags, modern equivalent, meaning-shift note, definition and Bahá'í usage.

How it was made: generated with AI in November 2026 in 28 batches from each word's context in these books, with the same automatic checks; the usage, root, part of speech, tags and modern equivalents were added in the same batches. Not yet reviewed by a translator; 83 entries are marked as uncertain readings.

dictionaries.name: Sample: Volume 164 English → Persian
dictionaries.description: Every English word form in the Volume 164 translations, with its pronunciation written in Persian script, a Persian equivalent, and a definition in Persian. Used by Words: English and the tooltip on English words.
dictionaries.source: AI-generated from the Volume 164 English texts in November 2026; not reviewed by a translator.
about: Scope: every English word form in the authorized and provisional translations of Volume 164, for readers who know Persian and are reading the English. Used by Words: English with فارسی, and by tooltips on English words.

Contents: the English base form, the English word's pronunciation written in Persian script (God → گاد), a Persian equivalent chosen to match the vocabulary of the Persian originals where natural (friends → احبّا), and a definition in Persian. Persian/Arabic dictionaries are also searched from the English side, through their glosses, when this dictionary has no entry.

How it was made: generated with AI in November 2026 from each word's context in the Volume 164 translations; not reviewed; 18 entries are marked as uncertain. It does not yet cover the English of the Hidden Words, Kitáb-i-Íqán or Kitáb-i-Aqdas.

about: Scope: every English word form in the translations of Volume 164, for readers who know Arabic and are reading the English. Used by Words: English with العربية, and by tooltips on English words.

Contents: the English base form, its pronunciation written in Arabic letters (God → غاد), an Arabic equivalent in Modern Standard or classical Arabic, preferring the vocabulary of Bahá'í Arabic writings (friends → أحبّاء), and a definition in Arabic.

How it was made: generated with AI in November 2026 from each word's context in the Volume 164 translations; not reviewed; 12 entries are marked as uncertain. It does not yet cover the English of the Hidden Words, Kitáb-i-Íqán or Kitáb-i-Aqdas.
